text:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed our sampleapp surfaces a raw 502 from the gateway to users as `ServiceError: upstream reset`. Can we make this friendlier?
Owen: ugh yes that string is terrible in onboarding flows. Is this coming from the SDK or the gateway?
Maya: looks like SDK passes the gateway message verbatim into the error `message` field. No typed error mapping.
Sophie: +1 to mapping. For 5xx we usually want a concise hint: 'temporary service issue — please retry'. Maybe include a retry-after suggestion if we have it.
Javi: we should also distinguish auth vs transient vs quota. Right now clients can't programmatically decide.
Maya: proposal: SDK surfaces typed errors: AuthError, TransientError, QuotaError, ClientError. Keep original code in `.raw` but `message` becomes friendly copy + `hint`.
Owen: sounds good. Small UX note: keep `message` short for UIs, and add `details` or `raw` for logs. That avoids huge toast popups.
Sophie: Sample copy ideas: for 401 -> 'Authentication failed. Check your API key/credentials.' 429 -> 'Rate limited. Backoff and retry.' 502/503 -> 'Temporary service disruption. Try again shortly.'
Javi: agree. Also suggest an SDK helper `isRetryable(err)` and `retryHint(err)` so callers don't parse codes.
Maya: quick patch I prototyped: in Go/Node SDKs map HTTP status -> typed error class + hint. Example: 
```
// pseudo
if status >=500 { return TransientError("Temporary service disruption","retryable:true") }
```
Owen: can you drop that in the sampleapp repo so we can validate UI behaviour? I can add a tiny test to assert toast copy vs raw log.
Maya: will do. I'll add a test that simulates gateway 502 and asserts `err.message` contains 'Temporary service disruption' and `err.raw` contains 'upstream reset'.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: sampleapp/test -> run in staging at 15:30 UTC
Sophie: Also: doc change needed on SDK error contract page — add examples for typical patterns and migration notes.
Javi: one more edge: streaming responses emit partial errors (e.g., node stream 'error' events). SDK should emit typed error events not raw strings.
Maya: noted. I'll include streaming event mapping in the PR.
Owen: super. Action items: Maya - PR to sampleapp + unit test; Sophie - docs snippet and copy variants; Javi - add helper API proposal; Owen - add UI test. We should reconvene once PR is up. :thumbsup:
Maya: PR created: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412 — ready for review.
Owen: reviewing now. Thanks!"
